# Close — CRM API: overview

> Canonical URL: https://developers.apideck.com/apis/crm/close/overview

Close is the sales CRM designed to help small and medium-sized businesses close more deals. Build relationships, track communications, and manage your sales pipeline.
- Status: live
- Authentication: basic

- **important to know:** The key acts as the Close user who created it, with that user's full access and no way to narrow it. If that key is deleted, the connection stops working immediately and cannot be undone, so have each consumer create a dedicated key for the integration rather than reusing one.
- **webhooks:** No webhooks - Close events are not delivered to Apideck; data is read by polling the API.
- **difficulty:** moderate
- **partnership required:** false
- **account type required:** Any Close account, paid or on trial.
- **sandbox note:** Test with a free trial account, which runs 14 days and needs no credit card; Close documents no separate sandbox.
- **apideck credentials available:** false
- **consumer access level:** A Close user who can create an API key in their settings; Close does not name a required role.
- **responsibility matrix:**   - **area:** Enable the Close Connector
  - **customer:** ✓ Via Apideck Dashboard
  - **consumer:** ✓ In their Close settings
  - **area:** Create the API Key in Close
  - **area:** Supply the API Key in Vault
  - **consumer:** ✓
  - **area:** Store & Encrypt Credentials
  - **apideck:** ✓
  - **area:** Build via the Unified API
  - **customer:** ✓ Builds the requests
  - **apideck:** ✓ Maintains connector
  - **consumer:** ✓ Can delete the key anytime
  - **customer:** ✓ Via Apideck Dashboard
  - **area:** Monitor Connections
  - **apideck:** ✓ Logs & alerts
- **difficulty reason:** API Key Authentication - Each Consumer Creates Their Own Key in Close
- **sandbox url:** https://app.close.com/signup/
- **sandbox available:** true
- **authentication note:** Sent as the username in HTTP Basic authentication.
- **apideck credentials note:** Each consumer creates their own Close API key.
- **environment notes:**   - **environment:** Single environment
  - **description:** Close runs one production host, https://api.close.com/api/v1, for every account. Testing and production share the same kind of credential, a single user API key, so anything the integration writes during testing lands in a live Close account.
- **rate limits:** No single published figure; Close limits requests per endpoint group, per organisation and, lower, per API key.
- **beta:** false
- **costs:** Nothing extra: every Close plan includes API access.
- **external guides:**   - **source:** Close
  - **title:** Close API documentation
  - **url:** https://developer.close.com/
  - **url:** https://help.close.com/integrations/api-keys-oauth
